subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway owners accept this PR's forced `process.exit(0)` after non-restart shutdown completion, strict `/healthz?strict=1` supervised lock probe, and new `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS` default of 5 seconds?
rationale: The code appears correct and proven, but the remaining choice is operator-facing availability and upgrade behavior, not a narrow automation repair.

options.title: Accept the bounded recovery semantics
options.body: Land the PR after owner review, keeping public health endpoints compatible while using strict internal probing and the watchdog to recover zombie shutdowns.

options.title: Require a safer default first
options.body: Ask for a pre-merge change such as a different default, documentation, or an explicit owner-approved timeout shape before the watchdog can force exit.

options.title: Pause for broader shutdown design
options.body: Hold or close this branch if owners want zombie recovery solved through a larger Gateway lifecycle or crash-loop-breaker design instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recovery semantics
recommendation.body: Land the PR after owner review, keeping public health endpoints compatible while using strict internal probing and the watchdog to recover zombie shutdowns.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway lifecycle and docs history makes this the best available owner for the operator-facing shutdown/probe decision.
